invariants.title: Architectural Integrity
invariants.rule: Every component MUST belong to a declared architectural domain. No undefined ownership.

invariants.title: Single Responsibility Ownership
invariants.rule: Every critical responsibility MUST have one canonical owner.

invariants.title: Explicit Dependencies
invariants.rule: Dependencies MUST be explicit. No hidden imports or implicit coupling.

invariants.title: No Circular Dependencies
invariants.rule: The domain dependency graph MUST remain acyclic.

invariants.title: Explicit Identity
invariants.rule: Every security-relevant action MUST have an attributable identity.

invariants.title: Authentication Before Trust
invariants.rule: IDENTITY ≠ PERMISSION. Every privileged action requires explicit authorization.

invariants.title: Least Privilege
invariants.rule: Every actor receives only minimum required permissions.

invariants.title: Tenant Isolation
invariants.rule: A tenant MUST NOT access another tenant data without authorized, auditable access.

invariants.title: Explicit Tenant Context
invariants.rule: Tenant-scoped operations MUST have explicit tenant context.

invariants.title: Organization Ownership
invariants.rule: Resource → Project → Organization → Tenant lineage MUST remain traceable.

invariants.title: Data Integrity
invariants.rule: Persistent data MUST preserve identity, consistency, referential integrity, ownership.

invariants.title: Explicit Persistence Contracts
invariants.rule: PK / FK / UNIQUE / CHECK / INDEX / RELATIONSHIP / LIFECYCLE must be declared.

invariants.title: No Silent Schema Mutation
invariants.rule: Every structural change requires SPEC → MODEL → MIGRATION → TEST → VALIDATION.

invariants.title: Immutable Evidence
invariants.rule: Sealed evidence MUST NOT be modified; corrections create new versions.

invariants.title: Data Lineage
invariants.rule: SOURCE → TRANSFORMATION → DECISION → OUTPUT must remain traceable.

invariants.title: Explicit Execution Context
invariants.rule: Every execution MUST have execution_id, task_id, actor, tenant, policy_context.

invariants.title: No Uncontrolled Execution
invariants.rule: Untrusted or generated code MUST NOT execute outside approved runtime boundaries.

invariants.title: Resource Bounding
invariants.rule: Executions MUST be bounded by CPU, MEMORY, DISK, PID, TIMEOUT.

invariants.title: Cancellation and Termination
invariants.rule: Long executions MUST support controlled termination preserving evidence.

invariants.title: Failure Is Explicit
invariants.rule: UNKNOWN ≠ SUCCESS. Never convert unknown state into success.

invariants.title: Host Protection
invariants.rule: Host MUST remain protected from unauthorized FS, process, network, secret access.

invariants.title: Explicit Isolation
invariants.rule: FILESYSTEM / NETWORK / PROCESS / RESOURCE / IDENTITY boundaries MUST be explicit.

invariants.title: Default Deny
invariants.rule: Sandbox privileges: DENY BY DEFAULT, explicitly granted only.

invariants.title: No Secret Leakage
invariants.rule: Sandboxed execution MUST NOT receive credentials or production secrets.

invariants.title: Tool Identity
invariants.rule: Every registered tool MUST have tool_id, name, version, capabilities, contract.

invariants.title: Contract Validation
invariants.rule: Tool input/output MUST be validated against declared contracts.

invariants.title: Tool Authorization
invariants.rule: REGISTERED ≠ AUTHORIZED. Capability + policy evaluation before execution.

invariants.title: Tool Version Traceability
invariants.rule: Reproducibility MUST NOT depend on unspecified "latest".

invariants.title: Agent Identity
invariants.rule: Every autonomous agent MUST have explicit identity.

invariants.title: Capability Boundaries
invariants.rule: INTENT → CAPABILITY CHECK → POLICY CHECK → EXECUTION.

invariants.title: Agent Accountability
invariants.rule: Significant actions attributable to responsible agent identity.

invariants.title: Autonomy Is Governed
invariants.rule: AUTONOMY < POLICY. Autonomy never overrides governance.

invariants.title: Model Output Is Not Fact
invariants.rule: MODEL OUTPUT → VERIFICATION → EVIDENCE → TRUST LEVEL.

invariants.title: Uncertainty Must Be Representable
invariants.rule: VERIFIED / PROBABLE / UNCERTAIN / UNKNOWN / FALSE — unknown never becomes certain.

invariants.title: Decisions Require Context
invariants.rule: Significant cognitive decisions preserve decision context.

invariants.title: Explicit Task State
invariants.rule: Tasks MUST have explicit lifecycle states with controlled transitions.

invariants.title: Task Dependency Integrity
invariants.rule: Task MUST NOT execute before mandatory dependencies are satisfied.

invariants.title: Retry Is Governed
invariants.rule: Retries MUST have policy, max attempts, backoff, termination rule.

invariants.title: Observability By Design
invariants.rule: Critical execution paths MUST emit EVENTS, TRACES, METRICS, LOGS.

invariants.title: Correlation
invariants.rule: Related operations correlatable via trace_id, execution_id, task_id, agent_id.

invariants.title: Evidence Before Assertion
invariants.rule: Assertion without evidence has lower trust than assertion + verifiable evidence.

invariants.title: Evidence Integrity
invariants.rule: Evidence lifecycle: capture, identity, storage, integrity, lineage, retention.

invariants.title: Evidence Traceability
invariants.rule: Critical evidence linked to the action that produced it.

invariants.title: Replay Where Possible
invariants.rule: Critical executions SHOULD preserve replay information.

invariants.title: Policy Precedence
invariants.rule: POLICY DENY > MODEL > AGENT > TOOL > LOCAL IMPLEMENTATION.

invariants.title: Policy Is Explicit
invariants.rule: Security policy MUST be explicit, versioned, auditable.

invariants.title: Policy Version Traceability
invariants.rule: Critical actions record the applicable policy version.

invariants.title: Policy Explainability
invariants.rule: Decisions explainable through rule, condition, context, decision.

invariants.title: Zero Trust
invariants.rule: No internal component is automatically trusted.

invariants.title: Defense In Depth
invariants.rule: Critical protection MUST NOT depend on a single control.

invariants.title: Secret Minimization
invariants.rule: Logs, traces, errors avoid secret disclosure.

invariants.title: Security Failure Is Not Success
invariants.rule: UNKNOWN authorization → DENY.

invariants.title: Memory Is Not Automatic Truth
invariants.rule: Memory carries source, confidence, timestamp, scope, validation state.

invariants.title: Memory Has Governance
invariants.rule: Memory creation, consolidation, retrieval, deletion follow governance.

invariants.title: Memory Lineage
invariants.rule: Important memory preserves its origin.

invariants.title: Learning Requires Evidence
invariants.rule: Improvement NOT promoted because a model claims it is better.

invariants.title: Learning Is Reversible
invariants.rule: Promoted improvements support rollback.

invariants.title: Failure Is Learning Input
invariants.rule: Validated failures preserved as structured learning signals.

invariants.title: No Unverified Self-Modification
invariants.rule: No autonomous promotion of critical self-modifications without verification.

invariants.title: Separation Of Proposal And Approval
invariants.rule: The proposer MUST NOT be the sole approval authority.

invariants.title: Experiment Before Promotion
invariants.rule: PROPOSAL → EXPERIMENT → BENCHMARK → VERIFY → POLICY → APPROVE → CANARY → PROMOTE.

invariants.title: Rollback Capability
invariants.rule: Critical promoted changes MUST have rollback strategy.

invariants.title: Testable Architecture
invariants.rule: Critical logic MUST NOT hide behind untestable global state.

invariants.title: Compilation Is Not Validation
invariants.rule: Compilation success proves neither correctness nor security.

invariants.title: Regression Protection
invariants.rule: Validated capability MUST NOT silently regress.

invariants.title: No Silent Architectural Change
invariants.rule: Architectural changes MUST be explicit and versioned.

invariants.title: Impact Analysis
invariants.rule: Critical changes consider dependencies, security, policy, data, rollback.

invariants.title: Backward Compatibility
invariants.rule: Breaking changes MUST be explicit with migration paths.

invariants.title: Versioned Execution
invariants.rule: Critical executions identify software, config, tool, policy, environment versions.

invariants.title: Deterministic Control
invariants.rule: Non-determinism MUST be explicitly recognized.

invariants.title: Human Override
invariants.rule: Humans retain pause / cancel / approve / reject / rollback authority.

invariants.title: Explicit Override
invariants.rule: Human overrides attributable and auditable.

invariants.title: Fail Safely
invariants.rule: DO NOT GUESS. DO NOT ESCALATE PRIVILEGE. DO NOT ASSUME SUCCESS.

invariants.title: Failure Preserves Evidence
invariants.rule: Failure MUST NOT automatically erase evidence.
